criteria.rationale: The authorized three-step engineering task is traced through existing CI-R01/02/04/05 and AU-R01..04 to six scoped cases. Failed acquisition criteria are retained rather than weakened.

C0 coordinates one proposed decision, C4 admits model output, C1 owns original bytes, C3/C7 retain admission/authority. Complete references and nested native serialization are enforced without rewriting model content.

No solver, domain hypothesis, new owner or prescribed live operation is added. One response-mode distinction, exact-address decoder, duplicate-schema removal and central native serializer repair address observed failures. Generic access clarification leaves operation/stop choice to the student.

Lost initial raw state is declared unavailable. Retained repeat, preflight-capacity, nested serialization and clean-yield attempts stay distinct. The final student yielded without evidence acquisition; no ability or fundamental-impossibility claim is inferred.

Current run reports4018 input/170 output tokens and4188 policy units, zero unknown-usage jobs, within unchanged caps. Teacher was not requested. Free GPU/loopback services were stopped after verified export; no paid API, energy or comparative cost result is asserted.

Native regression preserves UNKNOWN_COMMIT on response loss; completed terminal reopen adds no broker/model call. Actual final fresh-process snapshot and eight-store integrity pass. Crash, cross-host and model-service restart remain outside this gate.

Observed raw native errors, actual xgrammar compilation, package freezes, model hashes, source/wheel equality and native broker/store regressions ground the repairs. Source-only checks are distinguished from live reasoning.

Acquisition and supported submission acceptance failed: the actual student chose yield after mission only, also after a generic access clarification. Native contract/dispatch pass cannot promote autonomous readiness. Broader original matrices remain REVISE.

Duplicate response schema exceeded exact input cap; field index preserves complete original data and full decoder.
Nested typed proposal/result values failed JSON serialization before connector/result completion; native conversion and full authored dispatch regression now pass.
Actual student yielded at the mission despite access catalogue, including after generic access clarification. Acquisition/submission criteria fail for this student/protocol setup.
Initial expired native state is unavailable; only retained notebook/source/printed counts support that attempt.
Original broad component scenarios, scientific qualification, crash/isolation/scale and teacher advantage remain unestablished.
